an intermediate level: After two years of practice, Amy's Japanese has reached an intermediate level, so she can chat but cannot read newspapers yet.
經過兩年的練習，艾美的日文已達到中級程度，她能聊天但還看不懂報紙。
an intermediate stage: The bridge project is now at an intermediate stage: the base is finished, but work on the road on top has not started.
這座橋的工程目前處於中間階段：基座已完成，但上方道路的工程還沒開始。
intermediate learners: This textbook is designed for intermediate learners who already know basic grammar but want to improve their writing.
這本課本是為已經懂基本文法、但想提升寫作能力的中級學習者設計的。
an intimate friend: Linda is an intimate friend of mine; we have shared all our secrets since we were in elementary school.
琳達是我的密友；從小學開始我們就分享彼此所有的秘密。
an intimate knowledge of: Having grown up in Tainan, the tour guide has an intimate knowledge of the city's old streets and hidden food stands.
這位導遊在台南長大，對這座城市的老街和隱藏版小吃攤十分熟悉。
an intimate relationship: Trust and honest communication are necessary for building an intimate relationship between two people in love.
信任與坦誠的溝通是兩個相愛的人建立親密關係所必需的。
an intimate atmosphere: With soft music and candles on every table, the small café has an intimate atmosphere that couples love.
這家小咖啡館有輕柔的音樂，每張桌上都點著蠟燭，營造出情侶們喜愛的溫馨私密的氣氛。
be on intimate terms with: The magazine claimed the singer was on intimate terms with a famous actor, and photos showed them kissing on a beach.
雜誌聲稱這位歌手與一位知名男演員關係親密，照片還拍到兩人在海灘上接吻。
an ivory tower: Professors who stay in an ivory tower may not understand the real problems that ordinary workers face every day.
待在象牙塔裡的教授可能不了解一般勞工每天面對的真正問題。
the ivory trade: To protect elephants from hunters, many countries have banned the ivory trade and destroyed piles of illegal tusks.
為了保護大象不被獵殺，許多國家已禁止象牙貿易，並銷毀成堆的非法象牙。
live in an ivory tower: Some critics say politicians live in an ivory tower and have no idea how expensive rent is for young people.
有些批評者說政治人物活在象牙塔裡，完全不知道房租對年輕人來說有多貴。
be jealous of someone's success: Instead of being jealous of his classmate's success, Ken congratulated her and asked how she had prepared for the contest.
肯沒有嫉妒同學的成功，反而恭喜她，並問她是如何準備比賽的。
a jealous husband: The jealous husband checked his wife's phone every night because he worried she was talking to other men.
那個愛猜忌的丈夫每晚都檢查妻子的手機，因為他擔心她在跟別的男人聊天。
guard something jealously: The chef guards his secret sauce recipe jealously and refuses to share it even with his own assistants.
這位主廚小心守護他的祕密醬汁食譜，連自己的助手都不肯透露。
jealous rage: In a jealous rage, the boy tore up the love letter his girlfriend had received from another student.
那個男孩在嫉妒的怒火中，撕毀了女友從另一個同學那裡收到的情書。
a joyful occasion: The wedding was a joyful occasion, with relatives laughing, singing, and dancing together until midnight.
那場婚禮是個喜慶的場合，親戚們一起歡笑、唱歌、跳舞直到半夜。
joyful news: The whole family cried with happiness when they heard the joyful news that Grandma's surgery was successful.
聽到奶奶手術成功的喜訊時，全家人都喜極而泣。
a joyful noise: On New Year's Eve, the children made a joyful noise with drums and whistles as the fireworks began.
除夕夜煙火開始時，孩子們用鼓和哨子發出歡樂的喧鬧聲。
the judicial system: People will only trust the judicial system if judges make fair decisions without being influenced by politicians.
只有法官能不受政治人物影響、做出公正的判決，人民才會信任司法制度。
judicial review: Through judicial review, the court can decide that a new law goes against the constitution and stop it from taking effect.
透過司法審查，法院可以判定一項新法律違憲並阻止它生效。
judicial independence: Judicial independence means that judges can make decisions freely without pressure from the government or powerful businesses.
司法獨立是指法官能自由做出判決，不受政府或大企業的壓力。
a juicy story: The magazine paid a lot of money for a juicy story about the pop star's secret marriage.
那本雜誌花了大筆錢買下一則關於流行歌手祕密結婚的有料八卦。
juicy gossip: My aunt always shares juicy gossip about our neighbors, like who is dating whom and who just got fired.
我阿姨總愛分享鄰居的精彩八卦，像是誰在和誰交往、誰剛被開除。
a juicy contract: The small company was thrilled to win a juicy contract worth millions of dollars from the government.
這家小公司很興奮能從政府那裡拿到一份價值數百萬元、油水多的合約。
juicy details: Everyone gathered around Mia at lunch, eager to hear the juicy details of her date with the most popular boy in school.
午餐時大家圍在米亞身邊，急著想聽她和全校最受歡迎男生約會的精彩細節。
be junior to: Although Mr. Lin is junior to his manager in position, he actually has more experience in sales.
雖然林先生的職位低於他的經理，但他其實有更多的業務經驗。
a junior partner: After five years at the law firm, she became a junior partner and hopes to become a senior partner someday.
在律師事務所工作五年後，她成為初級合夥人，並希望有一天能成為資深合夥人。
junior high school: My little brother will graduate from junior high school this summer and start senior high in September.
我弟弟今年夏天將從國中畢業，九月開始上高中。
junior staff: The company offers training programs for junior staff who have just graduated and joined the team this year.
公司為今年剛畢業、加入團隊的基層員工提供培訓課程。
the junior varsity: Since he was only a freshman, Ryan played on the junior varsity before moving up to the main basketball team.
因為萊恩才高一，他先在校隊二隊打球，之後才升上籃球校隊一隊。
